style.description: Style name (e.g. 'dracula', 'bubble') or path to JSON style file.

width.description: Word-wrap width; set to 0 to disable wrapping.

show_system_files.description: Show system files and directories (TUI-mode only).

config_file.description: Path to config file. Empty string uses default location.

completion_shells.description: List of shell completions to configure. Each item must contain 'name' and optionally 'no_descriptions'.
